source: The four attributes APFM_Flow writes in its UpdateContactAttributes block (action eeae1640-8792-4bd2-8afd-d071c3d10aca), sourced from APFM_Bot's customerintake slots. These are the same four the APFM_Intake_Guide view renders as $.Attributes.*, so this panel and the agent's step-by-step guide read the identical values.

attributes.label: Relationship
attributes.help: From the RelationType slot — who the caller is to the person they are enquiring for.

attributes.label: Interest
attributes.help: From the InterestType slot — the service the caller asked about.
